capabilities: Insert a link to a Zotero item via a command palette command
Connect to Zotero 7's local API or the ZotServer addon for Zotero 6
Customize link text with template variables like title, authors, and date
Use Nunjucks syntax and filters in link templates
extras: Requires different setup depending on Zotero version: the Local API in Zotero 7, or the ZotServer addon for Zotero 6 and earlier. A video review by Curtis McHale is linked in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert links to items in a Zotero reference library.

relations.evidence: Insert link to a Zotero item.
Install zotero-bridge and this plugin from Obsidian Community Plugins settings screen.

summary: Command that inserts a link to a Zotero item, with link text built from a configurable Nunjucks template.
